data.title: 风见一姬 · 朔风飞雪中的傲雪回眸
data.description: 【风见一姬 · 朔风飞雪中的傲雪回眸】白雪覆盖的荒凉雪山山脊之巅，狂暴的暴风雪呼啸撕扯着天地。一姬踏在深厚的积雪之中，不仅毫无畏惧，反而在风雪中心停步侧身回眸。雪花沾落在她如瀑布般的长长银发与长长睫毛上，深红色的眼眸在纯白的世界中璀璨如火，展现出与天地抗争的超越性生命力量。
data.location: 暴风雪席卷的陡峭雪山山脊
data.action: 在深雪中独立驻足侧身回眸，风雪撕扯长发与白裙，红瞳如炬傲雪凌霜
data.lighting: 暴风雪中极高亮度的白光漫射与冷冽灰影
data.camera: full body, 3/4 dynamic perspective, majestic snowscape scale
data.promptProse: Kazuki pauses mid-stride on a deep-snow mountain ridge and turns sideways to look back, long silver hair swept by the blizzard above her white linen sundress. Snowflakes cling to her lashes. The full-body three-quarter view keeps the ridge beneath her and layered snowbanks disappearing behind. Bright snow-filtered daylight reveals her red eyes and dress edge, with cold-gray terrain shadows marking the path amid the blowing white air.
